comparisons.peer_summary: Fixed Income Markets revenues increased 1%, driven by a 20% rise in spread products and other fixed income due to client activity in asset-backed financing and securitization, partially offset by lower rates/currencies revenues (-6%) and lower commodities revenues.
comparisons.comparison: Both Morgan Stanley (MS) and Citigroup (C) report specific growth in Fixed Income markets driven by credit/spread products and client activity, though they report different year-over-year growth rates. MS reported a 10% increase in Fixed Income net revenues driven by Credit and Global macro products. C reported a 1% increase in Fixed Income Markets revenues driven by a 20% rise in spread products, while noting declines in rates/currencies and commodities. Both disclose that spread/credit products were a key positive driver, contrasting with volatility or other factors affecting other segments.

sentences.text: Net revenues of $8,418 million in 2024 increased 10% compared with the prior year, reflecting an increase across businesses, particularly in Credit and Global macro products.
• Credit products revenues increased primarily due to higher lending and securitized products revenues and lower losses on inventory held to facilitate client activity in corporate credit products.
Fixed Income Markets revenues increased 1%, driven by spread products and other fixed income, partially offset by lower revenues in rates and currencies.
Spread products and other fixed income revenues increased 20%, largely driven by increased client activity due to growth in asset-backed financing, securitization activity and underwriting fees.
